description: NEXUS multi-agent orchestration playbook from agency-agents-zh. Full operating manual for coordinating AI expert agents into a pipeline - 7 phase playbooks (discovery to operations), 4 scenario scripts (startup MVP, enterprise feature, incident response, marketing campaign), handoff templates and agent activation prompts. Use when orchestrating multiple role-card agents on one project, defining quality gates, or planning sprint-style agent workflows.
